    name: contributions
    description: Specific actions taken by an Agent toward the creation, modification,
      validation, or deprecation of an Information Entity.
    comments:
    - This attribute holds one or more Contribution objects, which provide structured
      descriptions of a contribution made to the Information Entity by a particular
      agent.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    alias: contributions
    owner: EvidencePacket
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    - RecordMetadata
    range: Contribution
    required: false
    multivalued: true
  date_authored:
    name: date_authored
    description: Indicates when the information content expressed in the Information
      Entity was generated.
    comments:
    - The term 'authored' as used in the model refers to the generation of 'information
      content' in the abstract  sense, as opposed to a concrete encoding of this information
      in a specific language or format. e.g. for a Statement, this attribute captures
      when the information content expressed in the Statement was first generated
      by an agent.  Information about when a particular concrete encoding of this
      information was created (e.g. as row in a table, or object in a json document)
      would live in a RecordMetadata object attached to the Information Entity).
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: sepio-model:dateAuthored
    alias: date_authored
    owner: EvidencePacket
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    range: string
    required: false
    multivalued: false
  specified_by:
    name: specified_by
    description: A specification that describes all or part of the process that led
      to creation of the Information Entity.
    comments:
    - Examples - an experimental protocol or data analysis specification that describe
      how data were generated, or an evidence interpretation guideline that describes
      steps taken to interpret data in making a variant pathogenicity classification.
    - Note that this attribute captures specific *instances* of specifications/methods
      (e.g. the specific electron microscopy method described in https://doi.org/10.1002/
      cpz1.1045) - as opposed to reporting a *type* of method applied (e.g. "Transmission
      Electron Microscopy").
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: sepio-model:specifiedBy
    alias: specified_by
    owner: EvidencePacket
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    - Activity
    range: string
    required: false
    multivalued: true
  supporting_methods:
    name: supporting_methods
    description: Specific methods that were executed to directly or indirectly support
      creation of the Information Entity.
    comments:
    - These may include methods that directly produced the Information Entity, or
      upstream/accessory methods that indirectly support creation of the Information
      Entity - e.g. methods used to produce data that was interpreted as evidence
      to generate a Statement of knowledge.
    - This field captures terms representing specific INSTANCES of methods applied,
      vs the 'supportingMethodTypes' attribute which captures TYPES of methods used.

      or indirectly support creation of the Information Entity.

      or'supportingMethods' attributes which capture specific INSTANCES of methods
      used. These may include types of methods that directly produced the Information
      Entity, or upstream/accessory methods that indirectly support creation of the
      Information Entity
    - Implementers should define a relevant source or set of method type codes/terms
      to use here, based on the needs of the domain or application.'

    range: InformationEntity
    required: false
    multivalued: true
  reported_in:
    name: reported_in
    description: A document in which the Information Entity is reported.
    comments:
    - This attribute is used specifically to reference documents/publications where
      the Information Entity is expressed or reported.  For a Statement, this might
      be a publication where the authors express the statement in text. For a Data
      Item, this might be a publication with a table or figure that reports the value
      of the  data.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: sepio-model:reportedIn
    alias: reported_in
    owner: EvidencePacket
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    range: string
    required: false
    multivalued: true
  sources:
    name: sources
    description: A document or other informtion resource in which the information
      entity, or evidence supporting it, is reported.
    comments:
    - This attribute is more general than InformationEntity.reportedIn (which is used
      to references a Docuement that directly reports the infrormation), and Statement.hasEvidenceFromSources
      (which is used to reference resources that provided evidence used to generate
      the knowledge expressed in a Statement). It can be used to cover both cases,
      in situations where a data provider does not know which is the case, or does
      not wish to make the distinction.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    alias: sources
    owner: EvidencePacket
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    range: string
    required: false
    multivalued: true
  information_quality:
    name: information_quality
    description: A qualitative term indicating the scientific rigor or reliability
      with which the information was generated/collected.
    comments:
    - This is typically based on the quality of design and execution of the study
      or curation activity that generated it (e.g. were relevant controls assessed
      to show instruments were working, were all samples taken care of and handled
      identically, are methods sound and well documented, etc.).
    - The quality of information is intrinsic to the information itself, and not to
      a particular application of the information (e.g. as evidence for making an
      Assertion)
    - The quality of information is one factor that goes into the confidence we have
      in the information''s veracity (i.e. that it is an accurate reflection of reality
      it intends to measure or describe). Other factors informing confidence may include
      who did it (we may just not trust some Agents), when (if data created 500 years
      ago, we may have less confidence in it), and for Assertions, the relevance and
      abundance of supporting evidence.
    - Implementers should define a relevant source of codes or terms to use here,
      based on the needs of the domain or application.'
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Informative
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: sepio-model:informationQuality
    alias: information_quality
    owner: EvidencePacket
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    range: Coding
    required: false
    multivalued: false

      as encoded/serialized in a particular data set or object (as opposed to provenance
      about the abstract information content the encoding carries).
    comments:
    - This attribute holds a structured RecordMetadata objects, which can be used
      to capture when, how, and by whom a record serialization was generated or modified;
      what upstream resources it was derived or retrieved from; and record-level administrative
      information such as versioning and lifecycle status.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: sepio-model:recordMetadata
    alias: record_metadata
    owner: EvidencePacket
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    range: RecordMetadata
    required: false
    multivalued: false
  id:
    name: id
    description: The 'logical' identifier of the entity in the system of record, e.g.
      a UUID.  This 'id' is unique within a given system, but may or may not be globally
      unique outside the system. It is used within a system to reference one object
      from another.
    comments:
    - Note that it is common for implementers to create their own internal logical
      ids - typically a serially or randomly generated value like a UUID that is assigned
      to the data object as it is created in a system. But an implementer may choose
      to reuse an existing, globally unique id from an external system or authority
      for this purpose (e.g. an HGNC id for a Gene object) - as long as it is unique
      within the implementing system, and can be used to reference the identified
      object in this context.

    status: Draft
    identifier: true
    alias: id

    required: true
    multivalued: false

      real-world entity represented by a data object. These are typically assigned
      by an external system or authority, and used to connect entities and share content
      across different systems.

      provisioned the identifier is clear.

      identifiers defined by different systems, which can be captured in the "identifiers"
      property to indicate that they represent the same thing.

      descriptions of a contribution made to the Information Entity by a particular
      agent.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    alias: contributions
    owner: EvidencePacketCollection
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    - RecordMetadata
    range: Contribution
    required: false
    multivalued: true
  date_authored:
    name: date_authored
    description: Indicates when the information content expressed in the Information
      Entity was generated.
    comments:
    - The term 'authored' as used in the model refers to the generation of 'information
      content' in the abstract  sense, as opposed to a concrete encoding of this information
      in a specific language or format. e.g. for a Statement, this attribute captures
      when the information content expressed in the Statement was first generated
      by an agent.  Information about when a particular concrete encoding of this
      information was created (e.g. as row in a table, or object in a json document)
      would live in a RecordMetadata object attached to the Information Entity).
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: sepio-model:dateAuthored
    alias: date_authored
    owner: EvidencePacketCollection
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    range: string
    required: false
    multivalued: false
  specified_by:
    name: specified_by
    description: A specification that describes all or part of the process that led
      to creation of the Information Entity.
    comments:
    - Examples - an experimental protocol or data analysis specification that describe
      how data were generated, or an evidence interpretation guideline that describes
      steps taken to interpret data in making a variant pathogenicity classification.
    - Note that this attribute captures specific *instances* of specifications/methods
      (e.g. the specific electron microscopy method described in https://doi.org/10.1002/
      cpz1.1045) - as opposed to reporting a *type* of method applied (e.g. "Transmission
      Electron Microscopy").
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: sepio-model:specifiedBy
    alias: specified_by
    owner: EvidencePacketCollection
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    - Activity
    range: string
    required: false
    multivalued: true
  supporting_methods:
    name: supporting_methods
    description: Specific methods that were executed to directly or indirectly support
      creation of the Information Entity.
    comments:
    - These may include methods that directly produced the Information Entity, or
      upstream/accessory methods that indirectly support creation of the Information
      Entity - e.g. methods used to produce data that was interpreted as evidence
      to generate a Statement of knowledge.
    - This field captures terms representing specific INSTANCES of methods applied,
      vs the 'supportingMethodTypes' attribute which captures TYPES of methods used.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Informative
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: sepio-model:supportingMethods
    alias: supporting_methods
    owner: EvidencePacketCollection
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    range: string
    required: false
    multivalued: true
  supporting_method_types:
    name: supporting_method_types
    annotations:
      requirements:
        tag: requirements
        value: PROV.ENCODING.METHOD_TYPES
    description: Kinds of encoding used (LinkML-Map, SSSOM export, OWL serialisation).
    comments:
    - This field captures terms representing TYPES of methods applied, vs the 'specifiedBy'
      or'supportingMethods' attributes which capture specific INSTANCES of methods
      used. These may include types of methods that directly produced the Information
      Entity, or upstream/accessory methods that indirectly support creation of the
      Information Entity
    - Implementers should define a relevant source or set of method type codes/terms
      to use here, based on the needs of the domain or application.'
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Informative
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: sepio-model:supportingMethodTypes
    alias: supporting_method_types
    owner: EvidencePacketCollection
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    range: Coding
    required: false
    multivalued: true
  derived_from:
    name: derived_from
    description: Another Information Entity from which this Information Entity is
      derived, in whole or in part.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: sepio-model:derivedFrom
    alias: derived_from
    owner: EvidencePacketCollection
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    range: InformationEntity
    required: false
    multivalued: true
  reported_in:
    name: reported_in
    description: A document in which the Information Entity is reported.
    comments:
    - This attribute is used specifically to reference documents/publications where
      the Information Entity is expressed or reported.  For a Statement, this might
      be a publication where the authors express the statement in text. For a Data
      Item, this might be a publication with a table or figure that reports the value
      of the  data.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: sepio-model:reportedIn
    alias: reported_in
    owner: EvidencePacketCollection
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    range: string
    required: false
    multivalued: true
  sources:
    name: sources
    description: A document or other informtion resource in which the information
      entity, or evidence supporting it, is reported.
    comments:
    - This attribute is more general than InformationEntity.reportedIn (which is used
      to references a Docuement that directly reports the infrormation), and Statement.hasEvidenceFromSources
      (which is used to reference resources that provided evidence used to generate
      the knowledge expressed in a Statement). It can be used to cover both cases,
      in situations where a data provider does not know which is the case, or does
      not wish to make the distinction.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    alias: sources
    owner: EvidencePacketCollection
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    range: string
    required: false
    multivalued: true
  information_quality:
    name: information_quality
    description: A qualitative term indicating the scientific rigor or reliability
      with which the information was generated/collected.
    comments:
    - This is typically based on the quality of design and execution of the study
      or curation activity that generated it (e.g. were relevant controls assessed
      to show instruments were working, were all samples taken care of and handled
      identically, are methods sound and well documented, etc.).
    - The quality of information is intrinsic to the information itself, and not to
      a particular application of the information (e.g. as evidence for making an
      Assertion)
    - The quality of information is one factor that goes into the confidence we have
      in the information''s veracity (i.e. that it is an accurate reflection of reality
      it intends to measure or describe). Other factors informing confidence may include
      who did it (we may just not trust some Agents), when (if data created 500 years
      ago, we may have less confidence in it), and for Assertions, the relevance and
      abundance of supporting evidence.
    - Implementers should define a relevant source of codes or terms to use here,
      based on the needs of the domain or application.'
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Informative
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: sepio-model:informationQuality
    alias: information_quality
    owner: EvidencePacketCollection
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    range: Coding
    required: false
    multivalued: false

    name: record_metadata
    annotations:
      requirements:
        tag: requirements
        value: PROV.ENCODING.AGENT PROV.ENCODING.SYSTEM
    description: 'Artefact-level encoding provenance: record_identifier = where the
      artefact lives; contributions = the pipeline that serialised it.'
    comments:
    - This attribute holds a structured RecordMetadata objects, which can be used
      to capture when, how, and by whom a record serialization was generated or modified;
      what upstream resources it was derived or retrieved from; and record-level administrative
      information such as versioning and lifecycle status.

    rank: 1000

    alias: record_metadata
    owner: EvidencePacketCollection
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    range: RecordMetadata
    required: false
    multivalued: false

    name: id
    description: The 'logical' identifier of the entity in the system of record, e.g.
      a UUID.  This 'id' is unique within a given system, but may or may not be globally
      unique outside the system. It is used within a system to reference one object
      from another.
    comments:
    - Note that it is common for implementers to create their own internal logical
      ids - typically a serially or randomly generated value like a UUID that is assigned
      to the data object as it is created in a system. But an implementer may choose
      to reuse an existing, globally unique id from an external system or authority
      for this purpose (e.g. an HGNC id for a Gene object) - as long as it is unique
      within the implementing system, and can be used to reference the identified
      object in this context.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft

    alias: id
    owner: EvidencePacketCollection
    domain_of:

    - Entity
    range: string
    required: true

      real-world entity represented by a data object. These are typically assigned
      by an external system or authority, and used to connect entities and share content
      across different systems.
    comments:
    - Preferred values for this attribute are CURIEs or URIs - so the system that
      provisioned the identifier is clear.
    - A given real world entity - e.g. a genetic variant - may have many business
      identifiers defined by different systems, which can be captured in the "identifiers"
      property to indicate that they represent the same thing.

    rank: 1000

    domain_of:
    - UpstreamItem
    range: ResourceRole
  is_about:
    name: is_about
    description: An entity or concept in the world that the information entity describes/is
      about.
    comments:
    - e.g. In the context of a Statement object, this attribute may be used to indicate
      entities/concepts it is about, in lieu of providing a more precise description
      of what the Statement asserts to be true using subject, predicate, object, and
      qualifier properties. e.g. the Statement that "BRCA2 c.8023A>G is pathogenic
      for Breast Cancer" might be annotated to be about the variant 'BRCA2 c.8023A>G',
      and the disease 'Breast Cancer'.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Informative
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: sepio-model:isAbout
    alias: is_about
    owner: ExternalRecord
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    range: string
    required: false
    multivalued: true
  contributions:
    name: contributions
    description: Specific actions taken by an Agent toward the creation, modification,
      validation, or deprecation of an Information Entity.
    comments:
    - This attribute holds one or more Contribution objects, which provide structured
      descriptions of a contribution made to the Information Entity by a particular
      agent.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    alias: contributions
    owner: ExternalRecord
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    - RecordMetadata
    range: Contribution
    required: false
    multivalued: true
  date_authored:
    name: date_authored
    annotations:
      requirements:
        tag: requirements
        value: PROV.EI.DATE
    description: When upstream created or last revised the record.
    comments:
    - The term 'authored' as used in the model refers to the generation of 'information
      content' in the abstract  sense, as opposed to a concrete encoding of this information
      in a specific language or format. e.g. for a Statement, this attribute captures
      when the information content expressed in the Statement was first generated
      by an agent.  Information about when a particular concrete encoding of this
      information was created (e.g. as row in a table, or object in a json document)
      would live in a RecordMetadata object attached to the Information Entity).
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: sepio-model:dateAuthored
    alias: date_authored
    owner: ExternalRecord
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    range: string
    required: false
    multivalued: false
  specified_by:
    name: specified_by
    description: A specification that describes all or part of the process that led
      to creation of the Information Entity.
    comments:
    - Examples - an experimental protocol or data analysis specification that describe
      how data were generated, or an evidence interpretation guideline that describes
      steps taken to interpret data in making a variant pathogenicity classification.
    - Note that this attribute captures specific *instances* of specifications/methods
      (e.g. the specific electron microscopy method described in https://doi.org/10.1002/
      cpz1.1045) - as opposed to reporting a *type* of method applied (e.g. "Transmission
      Electron Microscopy").
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: sepio-model:specifiedBy
    alias: specified_by
    owner: ExternalRecord
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    - Activity
    range: string
    required: false
    multivalued: true
  supporting_methods:
    name: supporting_methods
    description: Specific methods that were executed to directly or indirectly support
      creation of the Information Entity.
    comments:
    - These may include methods that directly produced the Information Entity, or
      upstream/accessory methods that indirectly support creation of the Information
      Entity - e.g. methods used to produce data that was interpreted as evidence
      to generate a Statement of knowledge.
    - This field captures terms representing specific INSTANCES of methods applied,
      vs the 'supportingMethodTypes' attribute which captures TYPES of methods used.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Informative
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: sepio-model:supportingMethods
    alias: supporting_methods
    owner: ExternalRecord
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    range: string
    required: false
    multivalued: true
  supporting_method_types:
    name: supporting_method_types
    description: Types of methodological approaches that were executed to directly
      or indirectly support creation of the Information Entity.
    comments:
    - This field captures terms representing TYPES of methods applied, vs the 'specifiedBy'
      or'supportingMethods' attributes which capture specific INSTANCES of methods
      used. These may include types of methods that directly produced the Information
      Entity, or upstream/accessory methods that indirectly support creation of the
      Information Entity
    - Implementers should define a relevant source or set of method type codes/terms
      to use here, based on the needs of the domain or application.'
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Informative
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: sepio-model:supportingMethodTypes
    alias: supporting_method_types
    owner: ExternalRecord
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    range: Coding
    required: false
    multivalued: true
  derived_from:
    name: derived_from
    description: Another Information Entity from which this Information Entity is
      derived, in whole or in part.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: sepio-model:derivedFrom
    alias: derived_from
    owner: ExternalRecord
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    range: InformationEntity
    required: false
    multivalued: true
  reported_in:
    name: reported_in
    description: A document in which the Information Entity is reported.
    comments:
    - This attribute is used specifically to reference documents/publications where
      the Information Entity is expressed or reported.  For a Statement, this might
      be a publication where the authors express the statement in text. For a Data
      Item, this might be a publication with a table or figure that reports the value
      of the  data.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: sepio-model:reportedIn
    alias: reported_in
    owner: ExternalRecord
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    range: string
    required: false
    multivalued: true
  sources:
    name: sources
    description: A document or other informtion resource in which the information
      entity, or evidence supporting it, is reported.
    comments:
    - This attribute is more general than InformationEntity.reportedIn (which is used
      to references a Docuement that directly reports the infrormation), and Statement.hasEvidenceFromSources
      (which is used to reference resources that provided evidence used to generate
      the knowledge expressed in a Statement). It can be used to cover both cases,
      in situations where a data provider does not know which is the case, or does
      not wish to make the distinction.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    alias: sources
    owner: ExternalRecord
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    range: string
    required: false
    multivalued: true
  information_quality:
    name: information_quality
    annotations:
      requirements:
        tag: requirements
        value: PROV.EI.QUALITY
    description: Item-level quality where it deviates from the resource rating.
    comments:
    - This is typically based on the quality of design and execution of the study
      or curation activity that generated it (e.g. were relevant controls assessed
      to show instruments were working, were all samples taken care of and handled
      identically, are methods sound and well documented, etc.).
    - The quality of information is intrinsic to the information itself, and not to
      a particular application of the information (e.g. as evidence for making an
      Assertion)
    - The quality of information is one factor that goes into the confidence we have
      in the information''s veracity (i.e. that it is an accurate reflection of reality
      it intends to measure or describe). Other factors informing confidence may include
      who did it (we may just not trust some Agents), when (if data created 500 years
      ago, we may have less confidence in it), and for Assertions, the relevance and
      abundance of supporting evidence.
    - Implementers should define a relevant source of codes or terms to use here,
      based on the needs of the domain or application.'
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Informative
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: sepio-model:informationQuality
    alias: information_quality
    owner: ExternalRecord
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    range: Coding
    required: false
    multivalued: false
  record_metadata:
    name: record_metadata
    annotations:
      requirements:
        tag: requirements
        value: PROV.EI.RETRIEVAL_SOURCE
    description: Provenance metadata about a specific concrete record of information
      as encoded/serialized in a particular data set or object (as opposed to provenance
      about the abstract information content the encoding carries).
    comments:
    - This attribute holds a structured RecordMetadata objects, which can be used
      to capture when, how, and by whom a record serialization was generated or modified;
      what upstream resources it was derived or retrieved from; and record-level administrative
      information such as versioning and lifecycle status.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: sepio-model:recordMetadata
    alias: record_metadata
    owner: ExternalRecord
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    range: RetrievalMetadata
    required: true
    multivalued: false
  identifiers:
    name: identifiers
    description: A globally-unique 'business' identifier or accession number for the
      real-world entity represented by a data object. These are typically assigned
      by an external system or authority, and used to connect entities and share content
      across different systems.
    comments:
    - Preferred values for this attribute are CURIEs or URIs - so the system that
      provisioned the identifier is clear.
    - A given real world entity - e.g. a genetic variant - may have many business
      identifiers defined by different systems, which can be captured in the "identifiers"
      property to indicate that they represent the same thing.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Informative
    rank: 1000
    alias: identifiers
    owner: ExternalRecord
    domain_of:
    - Entity
    range: string
    required: false
    multivalued: true
  type:
    name: type
    description: The name of the class that is instantiated by a data object representing
      the Entity.
    comments:
    - MUST be the label of a concrete class from the data model.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    designates_type: true
    alias: type
    owner: ExternalRecord
    domain_of:
    - Entity
    range: string
    required: true
    multivalued: false
  label:
    name: label
    annotations:
      requirements:
        tag: requirements
        value: PROV.RETRIEVAL.ORIGINAL_NAMES_IDS
      decisions:
        tag: decisions
        value: D-010 D-067
    description: The record's label as read (original name), so label drift can trigger
      re-review.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    alias: label
    owner: ExternalRecord
    domain_of:
    - Entity
    - Coding
    range: string
    required: false
    multivalued: false
  alternative_labels:
    name: alternative_labels
    description: Alternative name(s) for the Entity.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: sepio-model:alternativeLabels
    alias: alternative_labels
    owner: ExternalRecord
    domain_of:
    - Entity
    range: string
    required: false
    multivalued: true
  description:
    name: description
    description: A free text description of the Entity.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    alias: description
    owner: ExternalRecord
    domain_of:
    - Entity
    range: string
    required: false
    multivalued: false
  extensions:
    name: extensions
    description: A list of extensions to the Entity, that allow for capture of information
      not directly supported by elements defined in the model.
    comments:
    - Extension objects have a key-value data structure that allows definition of
      custom fields in the data itself. Extensions are not expected to be natively
      understood, but may be used for pre-negotiated exchange of message attributes
      between systems.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    alias: extensions
    owner: ExternalRecord
    domain_of:
    - Entity
    range: Extension
    required: false
    multivalued: true

      entities/concepts it is about, in lieu of providing a more precise description
      of what the Statement asserts to be true using subject, predicate, object, and

      be a publication where the authors express the statement in text. For a Data
      Item, this might be a publication with a table or figure that reports the value

    rank: 1000

    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    range: string
    required: false
    multivalued: true

    name: sources

      entity, or evidence supporting it, is reported.

      to references a Docuement that directly reports the infrormation), and Statement.hasEvidenceFromSources
      (which is used to reference resources that provided evidence used to generate
      the knowledge expressed in a Statement). It can be used to cover both cases,
      in situations where a data provider does not know which is the case, or does
      not wish to make the distinction.

    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    alias: sources
    owner: GuidelineDocument
    domain_of:

    range: string
    required: false
    multivalued: true

    name: information_quality
    description: A qualitative term indicating the scientific rigor or reliability
      with which the information was generated/collected.
    comments:
    - This is typically based on the quality of design and execution of the study
      or curation activity that generated it (e.g. were relevant controls assessed
      to show instruments were working, were all samples taken care of and handled
      identically, are methods sound and well documented, etc.).

      real-world entity represented by a data object. These are typically assigned
      by an external system or authority, and used to connect entities and share content
      across different systems.

      identifiers defined by different systems, which can be captured in the "identifiers"

    domain_of:

    range: string
    required: true
    multivalued: false
  label:

    required: false
    multivalued: false
  alternative_labels:

    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model

    rank: 1000

    domain_of:

    rank: 1000

    owner: GuidelineDocument

    required: false
    multivalued: false
  extensions:
    name: extensions
    description: A list of extensions to the Entity, that allow for capture of information
      not directly supported by elements defined in the model.
    comments:
    - Extension objects have a key-value data structure that allows definition of
      custom fields in the data itself. Extensions are not expected to be natively

    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    alias: extensions
    owner: GuidelineDocument
    domain_of:
    - Entity
    range: Extension
    required: false
    multivalued: true

docs.title: Class: Information Entity (InformationEntity)
docs.text:
An abstract (non-physical) entity that is about something - representing the underlying 'information content' conveyed by physical or digital information artifacts like books, web pages, data tables, or photographs.

docs.title: Comments
docs.text: • As abstract, non-physical entities, Information Entities represent information independent of any specific language, format, or physical/digital medium. They can be simultaneously concretized in many distinct physical artifacts (e.g. all physical copies of the first edition of "War and Peace" carry the same information content, and thus concretize the same Information Entity).

docs.title: Induced
docs.text:
name: InformationEntity
description: An abstract (non-physical) entity that is about something - representing
  the underlying 'information content' conveyed by physical or digital information
  artifacts like books, web pages, data tables, or photographs.
title: Information Entity
comments:
- As abstract, non-physical entities, Information Entities represent information independent
  of any specific language, format, or physical/digital medium. They can be simultaneously
  concretized in many distinct physical artifacts (e.g. all physical copies of the
  first edition of "War and Peace" carry the same information content, and thus concretize
  the same Information Entity).
from_schema: https://w3id.org/sieve
status: Draft
is_a: Entity
attributes:
  is_about:
    name: is_about
    description: An entity or concept in the world that the information entity describes/is
      about.
    comments:
    - e.g. In the context of a Statement object, this attribute may be used to indicate
      entities/concepts it is about, in lieu of providing a more precise description
      of what the Statement asserts to be true using subject, predicate, object, and
      qualifier properties. e.g. the Statement that "BRCA2 c.8023A>G is pathogenic
      for Breast Cancer" might be annotated to be about the variant 'BRCA2 c.8023A>G',
      and the disease 'Breast Cancer'.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Informative
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: sepio-model:isAbout
    alias: is_about
    owner: InformationEntity
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    range: string
    required: false
    multivalued: true
  contributions:
    name: contributions
    description: Specific actions taken by an Agent toward the creation, modification,
      validation, or deprecation of an Information Entity.
    comments:
    - This attribute holds one or more Contribution objects, which provide structured
      descriptions of a contribution made to the Information Entity by a particular
      agent.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    alias: contributions
    owner: InformationEntity
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    - RecordMetadata
    range: Contribution
    required: false
    multivalued: true
  date_authored:
    name: date_authored
    description: Indicates when the information content expressed in the Information
      Entity was generated.
    comments:
    - The term 'authored' as used in the model refers to the generation of 'information
      content' in the abstract  sense, as opposed to a concrete encoding of this information
      in a specific language or format. e.g. for a Statement, this attribute captures
      when the information content expressed in the Statement was first generated
      by an agent.  Information about when a particular concrete encoding of this
      information was created (e.g. as row in a table, or object in a json document)
      would live in a RecordMetadata object attached to the Information Entity).
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: sepio-model:dateAuthored
    alias: date_authored
    owner: InformationEntity
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    range: string
    required: false
    multivalued: false
  specified_by:
    name: specified_by
    description: A specification that describes all or part of the process that led
      to creation of the Information Entity.
    comments:
    - Examples - an experimental protocol or data analysis specification that describe
      how data were generated, or an evidence interpretation guideline that describes
      steps taken to interpret data in making a variant pathogenicity classification.
    - Note that this attribute captures specific *instances* of specifications/methods
      (e.g. the specific electron microscopy method described in https://doi.org/10.1002/
      cpz1.1045) - as opposed to reporting a *type* of method applied (e.g. "Transmission
      Electron Microscopy").
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: sepio-model:specifiedBy
    alias: specified_by
    owner: InformationEntity
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    - Activity
    range: string
    required: false
    multivalued: true
  supporting_methods:
    name: supporting_methods
    description: Specific methods that were executed to directly or indirectly support
      creation of the Information Entity.
    comments:
    - These may include methods that directly produced the Information Entity, or
      upstream/accessory methods that indirectly support creation of the Information
      Entity - e.g. methods used to produce data that was interpreted as evidence
      to generate a Statement of knowledge.
    - This field captures terms representing specific INSTANCES of methods applied,
      vs the 'supportingMethodTypes' attribute which captures TYPES of methods used.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Informative
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: sepio-model:supportingMethods
    alias: supporting_methods
    owner: InformationEntity
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    range: string
    required: false
    multivalued: true
  supporting_method_types:
    name: supporting_method_types
    description: Types of methodological approaches that were executed to directly
      or indirectly support creation of the Information Entity.
    comments:
    - This field captures terms representing TYPES of methods applied, vs the 'specifiedBy'
      or'supportingMethods' attributes which capture specific INSTANCES of methods
      used. These may include types of methods that directly produced the Information
      Entity, or upstream/accessory methods that indirectly support creation of the
      Information Entity
    - Implementers should define a relevant source or set of method type codes/terms
      to use here, based on the needs of the domain or application.'
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Informative
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: sepio-model:supportingMethodTypes
    alias: supporting_method_types
    owner: InformationEntity
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    range: Coding
    required: false
    multivalued: true
  derived_from:
    name: derived_from
    description: Another Information Entity from which this Information Entity is
      derived, in whole or in part.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: sepio-model:derivedFrom
    alias: derived_from
    owner: InformationEntity
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    range: InformationEntity
    required: false
    multivalued: true
  reported_in:
    name: reported_in
    description: A document in which the Information Entity is reported.
    comments:
    - This attribute is used specifically to reference documents/publications where
      the Information Entity is expressed or reported.  For a Statement, this might
      be a publication where the authors express the statement in text. For a Data
      Item, this might be a publication with a table or figure that reports the value
      of the  data.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: sepio-model:reportedIn
    alias: reported_in
    owner: InformationEntity
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    range: string
    required: false
    multivalued: true
  sources:
    name: sources
    description: A document or other informtion resource in which the information
      entity, or evidence supporting it, is reported.
    comments:
    - This attribute is more general than InformationEntity.reportedIn (which is used
      to references a Docuement that directly reports the infrormation), and Statement.hasEvidenceFromSources
      (which is used to reference resources that provided evidence used to generate
      the knowledge expressed in a Statement). It can be used to cover both cases,
      in situations where a data provider does not know which is the case, or does
      not wish to make the distinction.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    alias: sources
    owner: InformationEntity
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    range: string
    required: false
    multivalued: true
  information_quality:
    name: information_quality
    description: A qualitative term indicating the scientific rigor or reliability
      with which the information was generated/collected.
    comments:
    - This is typically based on the quality of design and execution of the study
      or curation activity that generated it (e.g. were relevant controls assessed
      to show instruments were working, were all samples taken care of and handled
      identically, are methods sound and well documented, etc.).
    - The quality of information is intrinsic to the information itself, and not to
      a particular application of the information (e.g. as evidence for making an
      Assertion)
    - The quality of information is one factor that goes into the confidence we have
      in the information''s veracity (i.e. that it is an accurate reflection of reality
      it intends to measure or describe). Other factors informing confidence may include
      who did it (we may just not trust some Agents), when (if data created 500 years
      ago, we may have less confidence in it), and for Assertions, the relevance and
      abundance of supporting evidence.
    - Implementers should define a relevant source of codes or terms to use here,
      based on the needs of the domain or application.'
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Informative
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: sepio-model:informationQuality
    alias: information_quality
    owner: InformationEntity
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    range: Coding
    required: false
    multivalued: false
  record_metadata:
    name: record_metadata
    description: Provenance metadata about a specific concrete record of information
      as encoded/serialized in a particular data set or object (as opposed to provenance
      about the abstract information content the encoding carries).
    comments:
    - This attribute holds a structured RecordMetadata objects, which can be used
      to capture when, how, and by whom a record serialization was generated or modified;
      what upstream resources it was derived or retrieved from; and record-level administrative
      information such as versioning and lifecycle status.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: sepio-model:recordMetadata
    alias: record_metadata
    owner: InformationEntity
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    range: RecordMetadata
    required: false
    multivalued: false
  id:
    name: id
    description: The 'logical' identifier of the entity in the system of record, e.g.
      a UUID.  This 'id' is unique within a given system, but may or may not be globally
      unique outside the system. It is used within a system to reference one object
      from another.
    comments:
    - Note that it is common for implementers to create their own internal logical
      ids - typically a serially or randomly generated value like a UUID that is assigned
      to the data object as it is created in a system. But an implementer may choose
      to reuse an existing, globally unique id from an external system or authority
      for this purpose (e.g. an HGNC id for a Gene object) - as long as it is unique
      within the implementing system, and can be used to reference the identified
      object in this context.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    alias: id
    owner: InformationEntity
    domain_of:
    - EvidenceItem
    - Entity
    range: string
    required: true
    multivalued: false
  identifiers:
    name: identifiers
    description: A globally-unique 'business' identifier or accession number for the
      real-world entity represented by a data object. These are typically assigned
      by an external system or authority, and used to connect entities and share content
      across different systems.
    comments:
    - Preferred values for this attribute are CURIEs or URIs - so the system that
      provisioned the identifier is clear.
    - A given real world entity - e.g. a genetic variant - may have many business
      identifiers defined by different systems, which can be captured in the "identifiers"
      property to indicate that they represent the same thing.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Informative
    rank: 1000
    alias: identifiers
    owner: InformationEntity
    domain_of:
    - Entity
    range: string
    required: false
    multivalued: true
  type:
    name: type
    description: The name of the class that is instantiated by a data object representing
      the Entity.
    comments:
    - MUST be the label of a concrete class from the data model.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    alias: type
    owner: InformationEntity
    domain_of:
    - Entity
    range: string
    required: true
    multivalued: false
  label:
    name: label
    description: A primary name for the Entity.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    alias: label
    owner: InformationEntity
    domain_of:
    - Entity
    - Coding
    range: string
    required: false
    multivalued: false
  alternative_labels:
    name: alternative_labels
    description: Alternative name(s) for the Entity.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: sepio-model:alternativeLabels
    alias: alternative_labels
    owner: InformationEntity
    domain_of:
    - Entity
    range: string
    required: false
    multivalued: true
  description:
    name: description
    description: A free text description of the Entity.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    alias: description
    owner: InformationEntity
    domain_of:
    - Entity
    range: string
    required: false
    multivalued: false
  extensions:
    name: extensions
    description: A list of extensions to the Entity, that allow for capture of information
      not directly supported by elements defined in the model.
    comments:
    - Extension objects have a key-value data structure that allows definition of
      custom fields in the data itself. Extensions are not expected to be natively
      understood, but may be used for pre-negotiated exchange of message attributes
      between systems.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    alias: extensions
    owner: InformationEntity
    domain_of:
    - Entity
    range: Extension
    required: false
    multivalued: true

docs.title: Class: InformationResource
docs.text:
A registry entry for a source as a whole (OMIM, Orphanet, Disease Ontology, Wikipedia, GARD). It carries a dated quality rating, a default retrieval role and the resources it derives content from (dependence). It is the target of source-only citations.

    - InformationEntity
    - RecordMetadata
    range: Contribution
    required: false
    multivalued: true
  date_authored:
    name: date_authored
    description: Indicates when the information content expressed in the Information
      Entity was generated.
    comments:
    - The term 'authored' as used in the model refers to the generation of 'information
      content' in the abstract  sense, as opposed to a concrete encoding of this information
      in a specific language or format. e.g. for a Statement, this attribute captures
      when the information content expressed in the Statement was first generated
      by an agent.  Information about when a particular concrete encoding of this
      information was created (e.g. as row in a table, or object in a json document)
      would live in a RecordMetadata object attached to the Information Entity).
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: sepio-model:dateAuthored
    alias: date_authored
    owner: InformationResource
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    range: string
    required: false
    multivalued: false
  specified_by:
    name: specified_by
    description: A specification that describes all or part of the process that led
      to creation of the Information Entity.
    comments:
    - Examples - an experimental protocol or data analysis specification that describe
      how data were generated, or an evidence interpretation guideline that describes
      steps taken to interpret data in making a variant pathogenicity classification.
    - Note that this attribute captures specific *instances* of specifications/methods
      (e.g. the specific electron microscopy method described in https://doi.org/10.1002/
      cpz1.1045) - as opposed to reporting a *type* of method applied (e.g. "Transmission
      Electron Microscopy").
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: sepio-model:specifiedBy
    alias: specified_by
    owner: InformationResource
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    - Activity
    range: string
    required: false
    multivalued: true
  supporting_methods:
    name: supporting_methods
    description: Specific methods that were executed to directly or indirectly support
      creation of the Information Entity.
    comments:
    - These may include methods that directly produced the Information Entity, or
      upstream/accessory methods that indirectly support creation of the Information
      Entity - e.g. methods used to produce data that was interpreted as evidence
      to generate a Statement of knowledge.
    - This field captures terms representing specific INSTANCES of methods applied,
      vs the 'supportingMethodTypes' attribute which captures TYPES of methods used.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Informative
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: sepio-model:supportingMethods
    alias: supporting_methods
    owner: InformationResource
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    range: string
    required: false
    multivalued: true
  supporting_method_types:
    name: supporting_method_types
    description: Types of methodological approaches that were executed to directly
      or indirectly support creation of the Information Entity.
    comments:
    - This field captures terms representing TYPES of methods applied, vs the 'specifiedBy'
      or'supportingMethods' attributes which capture specific INSTANCES of methods
      used. These may include types of methods that directly produced the Information
      Entity, or upstream/accessory methods that indirectly support creation of the
      Information Entity
    - Implementers should define a relevant source or set of method type codes/terms
      to use here, based on the needs of the domain or application.'
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Informative
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: sepio-model:supportingMethodTypes
    alias: supporting_method_types
    owner: InformationResource
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    range: Coding
    required: false
    multivalued: true
  derived_from:
    name: derived_from
    description: Another Information Entity from which this Information Entity is
      derived, in whole or in part.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: sepio-model:derivedFrom
    alias: derived_from
    owner: InformationResource
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    range: InformationEntity
    required: false
    multivalued: true
  reported_in:
    name: reported_in
    description: A document in which the Information Entity is reported.
    comments:
    - This attribute is used specifically to reference documents/publications where
      the Information Entity is expressed or reported.  For a Statement, this might
      be a publication where the authors express the statement in text. For a Data
      Item, this might be a publication with a table or figure that reports the value
      of the  data.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: sepio-model:reportedIn
    alias: reported_in
    owner: InformationResource
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    range: string
    required: false
    multivalued: true
  sources:
    name: sources
    description: A document or other informtion resource in which the information
      entity, or evidence supporting it, is reported.
    comments:
    - This attribute is more general than InformationEntity.reportedIn (which is used
      to references a Docuement that directly reports the infrormation), and Statement.hasEvidenceFromSources
      (which is used to reference resources that provided evidence used to generate
      the knowledge expressed in a Statement). It can be used to cover both cases,
      in situations where a data provider does not know which is the case, or does
      not wish to make the distinction.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    alias: sources
    owner: InformationResource
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    range: string
    required: false
    multivalued: true
  information_quality:
    name: information_quality
    description: A qualitative term indicating the scientific rigor or reliability
      with which the information was generated/collected.
    comments:
    - This is typically based on the quality of design and execution of the study
      or curation activity that generated it (e.g. were relevant controls assessed
      to show instruments were working, were all samples taken care of and handled
      identically, are methods sound and well documented, etc.).
    - The quality of information is intrinsic to the information itself, and not to
      a particular application of the information (e.g. as evidence for making an
      Assertion)
    - The quality of information is one factor that goes into the confidence we have
      in the information''s veracity (i.e. that it is an accurate reflection of reality
      it intends to measure or describe). Other factors informing confidence may include
      who did it (we may just not trust some Agents), when (if data created 500 years
      ago, we may have less confidence in it), and for Assertions, the relevance and
      abundance of supporting evidence.
    - Implementers should define a relevant source of codes or terms to use here,
      based on the needs of the domain or application.'
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Informative
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: sepio-model:informationQuality
    alias: information_quality
    owner: InformationResource
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    range: Coding
    required: false
    multivalued: false
  record_metadata:
    name: record_metadata
    description: Provenance metadata about a specific concrete record of information
      as encoded/serialized in a particular data set or object (as opposed to provenance
      about the abstract information content the encoding carries).
    comments:
    - This attribute holds a structured RecordMetadata objects, which can be used
      to capture when, how, and by whom a record serialization was generated or modified;
      what upstream resources it was derived or retrieved from; and record-level administrative
      information such as versioning and lifecycle status.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: sepio-model:recordMetadata
    alias: record_metadata
    owner: InformationResource
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    range: RecordMetadata
    required: false
    multivalued: false
  id:
    name: id
    description: Resource identifier, preferably an infores CURIE.
    comments:
    - Note that it is common for implementers to create their own internal logical
      ids - typically a serially or randomly generated value like a UUID that is assigned
      to the data object as it is created in a system. But an implementer may choose
      to reuse an existing, globally unique id from an external system or authority
      for this purpose (e.g. an HGNC id for a Gene object) - as long as it is unique
      within the implementing system, and can be used to reference the identified
      object in this context.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    identifier: true
    alias: id
    owner: InformationResource
    domain_of:
    - EvidenceItem
    - Entity
    range: string
    required: true
    multivalued: false
  identifiers:
    name: identifiers
    description: A globally-unique 'business' identifier or accession number for the
      real-world entity represented by a data object. These are typically assigned
      by an external system or authority, and used to connect entities and share content
      across different systems.
    comments:
    - Preferred values for this attribute are CURIEs or URIs - so the system that
      provisioned the identifier is clear.
    - A given real world entity - e.g. a genetic variant - may have many business
      identifiers defined by different systems, which can be captured in the "identifiers"
      property to indicate that they represent the same thing.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Informative
    rank: 1000
    alias: identifiers
    owner: InformationResource
    domain_of:
    - Entity
    range: string
    required: false
    multivalued: true
  type:
    name: type
    description: The name of the class that is instantiated by a data object representing
      the Entity.
    comments:
    - MUST be the label of a concrete class from the data model.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    designates_type: true
    alias: type
    owner: InformationResource
    domain_of:
    - Entity
    range: string
    required: true
    multivalued: false
  label:
    name: label
    description: A primary name for the Entity.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    alias: label
    owner: InformationResource
    domain_of:
    - Entity
    - Coding
    range: string
    required: false
    multivalued: false
  alternative_labels:
    name: alternative_labels
    description: Alternative name(s) for the Entity.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: sepio-model:alternativeLabels
    alias: alternative_labels
    owner: InformationResource
    domain_of:
    - Entity
    range: string
    required: false
    multivalued: true
  description:
    name: description
    description: A free text description of the Entity.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    alias: description
    owner: InformationResource
    domain_of:
    - Entity
    range: string
    required: false
    multivalued: false
  extensions:
    name: extensions
    description: A list of extensions to the Entity, that allow for capture of information
      not directly supported by elements defined in the model.
    comments:
    - Extension objects have a key-value data structure that allows definition of
      custom fields in the data itself. Extensions are not expected to be natively
      understood, but may be used for pre-negotiated exchange of message attributes
      between systems.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    alias: extensions
    owner: InformationResource
    domain_of:
    - Entity
    range: Extension
    required: false
    multivalued: true

    description: The 'logical' identifier of the entity in the system of record, e.g.
      a UUID.  This 'id' is unique within a given system, but may or may not be globally
      unique outside the system. It is used within a system to reference one object
      from another.

      ids - typically a serially or randomly generated value like a UUID that is assigned
      to the data object as it is created in a system. But an implementer may choose
      to reuse an existing, globally unique id from an external system or authority

  qualifier:
    name: qualifier
    description: An additional piece of information that extends or refines the meaning
      of a Statement's core subject - predicate - object 'triple' - by providing additional
      detail, or constraining the statement to apply in a particular context.
    comments:
    - -The qualifier attribute allows representation of more complex, n-ary statements
      that may not be accommodated by a simple subject-predicate-object (SPO) triple.
      For example, if an SPO triple asserts that 'Variant X' - predicts sensitivity
      to - 'Treatment Y', a qualifier can be used to indicate that this applies in
      the context of a particular 'Disease Z'. Qualifiers can also add information
      that quantifies aspects of a Statement - e.g. for a Statement triple asserting
      that a 'Variant X'- causes - 'Phenotype Y', a qualifier can be used to add frequency/penetrance
      information that quantifies the percentage of carriers in which the phenotype
      is observed to manifest. Statement profiles may define more than one qualifier,
      as needed to capture different types of qualifying information.
    - The SEPIO core model specifies use of a key-value 'Qualifier' object to capture
      the meaning and value of each type of qualifying information relevant for a
      given type of Statement. But in practice, profiles for specific Statement types
      may choose to define one or more specializations of the generic 'qualifier'
      property as named attributes. This makes the data more succinct and parsable,
      and allows specific constraints to be applied and validated for different qualifiers.
      For example, a VariantPathogenicityStatement profile may define a named 'alleleOriginQualifier'
      attribute that is required, and a named 'geneContextQualifier' attribute that
      is optional - both of which conceptually specialize the core-im 'qualifier'
      property. Under this approach, the core 'qualifier' acts as a placeholder to
      seed such specializations, but is not used directly in Statement profiles.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Informative
    rank: 1000
    alias: qualifier
    owner: MappingStatement
    domain_of:
    - Statement
    - Proposition
    range: Qualifier
    required: false
    multivalued: true
  direction:
    name: direction
    annotations:
      requirements:
        tag: requirements
        value: PROV.ASSERTION.CONFIDENCE_SCORE
      decisions:
        tag: decisions
        value: D-063
    description: Sign of the inclusion score S (supports = S > 0, disputes = S < 0).
    comments:
    - Statements put forth a Proposition that expresses some possible fact about the
      world, and may provide an assessment of this proposition's validity (i.e. how
      likely it is to be true or false based on evaluated evidence). The semantics
      of the Proposition are captured in the 'subject',  'predicate', 'object', and
      optional 'qualifier' attributes. An assessment of the Proposition's validity
      can be captured using 'direction', 'strength', and 'score' attributes. The 'direction'  attribute
      is used to indicate whether the Statement's Proposition is *supported* by the
      agent's assessment (when evidence favors its validity), is *disputed* by the
      agent's assessment (when evidence argues against its validity), or remains *neutral*
      (when conflicting or insufficient evidence exists to assert one direction or
      the other).  (Enumerated values = 'supports', 'disputes', 'neutral').
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    alias: direction
    owner: MappingStatement
    domain_of:
    - Statement
    range: Direction
    required: false
    multivalued: false
  strength:
    name: strength
    annotations:
      requirements:
        tag: requirements
        value: PROV.ASSERTION.CONFIDENCE_CATEGORY EINT.CATEGORICAL_STRENGTH
      decisions:
        tag: decisions
        value: D-062 D-063
    description: The band of S (e.g. strong / moderate / weak), as declared by the
      rule that computed S. Derived, versioned with the rule, never asserted freehand.
    comments:
    - Statements put forth a Proposition that expresses some possible fact about the
      world, and may provide an assessment of this proposition's validity (i.e. how
      likely it is to be true or false based on evaluated evidence). The semantics
      of the Proposition are captured in the 'subject,' 'predicate', 'object', and
      optional 'qualifier' attributes. An assessment of the Proposition's validity
      can be captured using 'direction',  'strength', and 'score' attributes. The
      'strength' attribute is used to report the strength of this assessment in the
      direction indicated. Strength can be framed as a *level of confidence* that
      the Proposition is true or false, or as a *level of evidence* that supports
      or disputes it. Data creators can define the permissible values for the 'strength'
      attribute to indicate which of these facets is being assessed (e.g. 'high confidence'
      vs 'low confidence', or 'strong evidence' vs 'weak evidence') - or they can
      choose values that don't commit to one or the other if they don't want to make
      the distinction (e.g. 'high' vs 'medium' vs 'low').
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000

    domain_of:
    - Statement
    range: string
    required: false
    multivalued: false
  score:
    name: score
    annotations:
      requirements:
        tag: requirements
        value: PROV.ASSERTION.CONFIDENCE_SCORE EINT.NUMERICAL_STRENGTH
      decisions:
        tag: decisions
        value: D-047 D-048 D-063
    description: The current inclusion score S in [-1, 1], computed by the claim type's

    comments:
    - Statements put forth a Proposition that expresses some possible fact about the
      world, and may provide an assessment of this proposition's validity (i.e. how
      likely it is to be true or false based on evaluated evidence). The semantics
      of the Proposition are captured in the 'subject', 'predicate', 'object', and

    multivalued: true
  derived_from:
    name: derived_from
    description: Another Information Entity from which this Information Entity is
      derived, in whole or in part.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: sepio-model:derivedFrom
    alias: derived_from
    owner: MappingStatement
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    range: InformationEntity
    required: false
    multivalued: true
  reported_in:
    name: reported_in
    annotations:
      requirements:
        tag: requirements
        value: EI.PRIOR_CLAIM.DIRECT_STRUCTURED
    description: For a prior claim, the record or document that makes it.
    comments:
    - This attribute is used specifically to reference documents/publications where
      the Information Entity is expressed or reported.  For a Statement, this might
      be a publication where the authors express the statement in text. For a Data
      Item, this might be a publication with a table or figure that reports the value
      of the  data.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: sepio-model:reportedIn
    alias: reported_in
    owner: MappingStatement
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    range: EvidenceItem
    required: false
    multivalued: true
  sources:
    name: sources
    description: A document or other informtion resource in which the information
      entity, or evidence supporting it, is reported.
    comments:
    - This attribute is more general than InformationEntity.reportedIn (which is used
      to references a Docuement that directly reports the infrormation), and Statement.hasEvidenceFromSources
      (which is used to reference resources that provided evidence used to generate
      the knowledge expressed in a Statement). It can be used to cover both cases,
      in situations where a data provider does not know which is the case, or does
      not wish to make the distinction.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    alias: sources
    owner: MappingStatement
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    range: string
    required: false
    multivalued: true
  information_quality:
    name: information_quality
    description: A qualitative term indicating the scientific rigor or reliability
      with which the information was generated/collected.
    comments:
    - This is typically based on the quality of design and execution of the study
      or curation activity that generated it (e.g. were relevant controls assessed
      to show instruments were working, were all samples taken care of and handled
      identically, are methods sound and well documented, etc.).
    - The quality of information is intrinsic to the information itself, and not to
      a particular application of the information (e.g. as evidence for making an
      Assertion)
    - The quality of information is one factor that goes into the confidence we have
      in the information''s veracity (i.e. that it is an accurate reflection of reality
      it intends to measure or describe). Other factors informing confidence may include
      who did it (we may just not trust some Agents), when (if data created 500 years
      ago, we may have less confidence in it), and for Assertions, the relevance and
      abundance of supporting evidence.
    - Implementers should define a relevant source of codes or terms to use here,
      based on the needs of the domain or application.'
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Informative
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: sepio-model:informationQuality
    alias: information_quality
    owner: MappingStatement
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    range: Coding
    required: false
    multivalued: false
  record_metadata:
    name: record_metadata
    description: Provenance metadata about a specific concrete record of information
      as encoded/serialized in a particular data set or object (as opposed to provenance
      about the abstract information content the encoding carries).
    comments:
    - This attribute holds a structured RecordMetadata objects, which can be used
      to capture when, how, and by whom a record serialization was generated or modified;
      what upstream resources it was derived or retrieved from; and record-level administrative
      information such as versioning and lifecycle status.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: sepio-model:recordMetadata
    alias: record_metadata
    owner: MappingStatement
    domain_of:
    - InformationEntity
    range: RecordMetadata
    required: false
    multivalued: false
  identifiers:
    name: identifiers
    description: A globally-unique 'business' identifier or accession number for the
      real-world entity represented by a data object. These are typically assigned
      by an external system or authority, and used to connect entities and share content
      across different systems.
    comments:
    - Preferred values for this attribute are CURIEs or URIs - so the system that
      provisioned the identifier is clear.
    - A given real world entity - e.g. a genetic variant - may have many business
      identifiers defined by different systems, which can be captured in the "identifiers"
      property to indicate that they represent the same thing.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Informative
    rank: 1000
    alias: identifiers
    owner: MappingStatement
    domain_of:
    - Entity
    range: string
    required: false
    multivalued: true
  type:
    name: type
    description: The name of the class that is instantiated by a data object representing
      the Entity.
    comments:
    - MUST be the label of a concrete class from the data model.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    designates_type: true
    alias: type
    owner: MappingStatement
    domain_of:
    - Entity
    range: string
    required: true
    multivalued: false
  label:
    name: label
    description: A primary name for the Entity.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    alias: label
    owner: MappingStatement
    domain_of:
    - Entity
    - Coding
    range: string
    required: false
    multivalued: false
  alternative_labels:
    name: alternative_labels
    description: Alternative name(s) for the Entity.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    slot_uri: sepio-model:alternativeLabels
    alias: alternative_labels
    owner: MappingStatement
    domain_of:
    - Entity
    range: string
    required: false
    multivalued: true
  description:
    name: description
    description: A free text description of the Entity.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    alias: description
    owner: MappingStatement
    domain_of:
    - Entity
    range: string
    required: false
    multivalued: false
  extensions:
    name: extensions
    description: A list of extensions to the Entity, that allow for capture of information
      not directly supported by elements defined in the model.
    comments:
    - Extension objects have a key-value data structure that allows definition of
      custom fields in the data itself. Extensions are not expected to be natively
      understood, but may be used for pre-negotiated exchange of message attributes
      between systems.
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/sepio-model
    status: Draft
    rank: 1000
    alias: extensions
    owner: MappingStatement
    domain_of:
    - Entity
    range: Extension
    required: false
    multivalued: true

      decide which pattern to follow and drop attributes not required for their approach.
